answer: Verification runs in three steps. First, each new key locks a bond on a public ledge, tiered by how many keys its funder created in the last 20 epochs: the 1st pays 100 POA, the 2nd 200, so the nth pays 100n and 100 keys lock 505,000 POA for 12 epochs. Second, the key must open a cipher sealed to a future block hash, proving it waited and cannot pre-mint in bulk. Third, a gale audit randomly re-challenges 5% of keys each epoch; missing two replies slashes the full bond. One honest key risks only time; a farm pays quadratically and loses everything on correlated silence.
